# Siva Dheeraj - 3D Portfolio

> Portfolio of Siva Dheeraj, a full-stack developer and founding engineer at Applied Work (appliedwork.ai). He builds LLM systems, RAG pipelines, agent evaluation tooling and web products. Based in Surat, India.

This site has two versions of the same portfolio:
- /3d-portfolio/me.html - the main 3D scroll portfolio (experience and selected works)
- /3d-portfolio/ - a desktop-style (MacBook UI) version with the same content

## Facts
- Name: Siva Dheeraj (Siva Dheeraj Ethamsetti)
- Role: Founding engineer and technical lead, Applied Work; full-stack developer
- Focus: LLM systems, agent evaluations, RAG pipelines, GTM automation, browser games and web apps
- Location: Surat, India
